verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents workflow automation that runs on triggers without user involvement, such as routing leads and updating fields when a deal closes (docs-32). Zia can create workflows for you (docs-29), and you can build and deploy AI agents that execute tasks on your behalf (docs-37, docs-38, docs-39). Background mail triggers and a function-monitoring dashboard add further support (docs-25, docs-27). Missing for 10: detailed docs on scheduled or time-based triggers and how autonomous agents run, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended background execution.
